title: Bloom Blocks - Flower Block Puzzle
short: Drag flower blocks onto the board and clear full lines. Plan ahead and chase your best score.
desc:
A block puzzle where you drag pink flower blocks onto the board.

▶ How to play
Drag the blocks shown below onto the board. Fill a whole row or column and it clears for points.

▶ Think ahead
The game ends when no block fits anywhere. Plan which block goes where before you place it.

▶ Best score
Your best score is kept so you can try to beat it next time. Your current game carries on even after you close it.

A short ad may appear between rounds. No purchases and no sign-up; your records stay on your device.
